name: Phoenixmon (X Antibody)
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] ＜Blitz＞ (If your opponent has 1 or more memory, this Digimon may attack.)
[Your Turn] While [Phoenixmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, attach [End of Attack] to all of this Digimon's [On Deletion] effects.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 11000 DP or lower red Digimon card with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in any of its traits (other than [Sea Animal]) from your hand without paying the cost. Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as the Digimon this effect played.
